scope: 46 application table column definition components; private 131 and public 235. All accessible column name/type/default/generation/identity/NULL/collation/storage/ACL/RLS/owner declarations inspected. Constraints separately sampled and prior receipts reused; not full server source.

query_sql.private:
WITH raw AS (
SELECT n.nspname AS schema_name,cls.relname AS relation_name,a.attnum AS position,a.attname AS column_name,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) AS data_type,a.attnotnull AS not_null,a.attidentity::text AS identity_kind,a.attgenerated::text AS generated_kind,a.attstorage::text AS storage_kind,a.attcompression::text AS compression_kind,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) AS default_expr,CASE WHEN a.attcollation=0 OR a.attcollation='default'::regcollation THEN NULL ELSE a.attcollation::regcollation::text END AS collation_name,cls.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled,pg_get_userbyid(cls.relowner) AS owner_role,coalesce(a.attacl::text,'') AS explicit_column_acl
FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class cls ON cls.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=cls.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=a.attrelid AND d.adnum=a.attnum
WHERE a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND cls.relkind IN('r','p','v','m','f') AND n.nspname='private'),
norm AS (
SELECT *,concat_ws(' ',quote_ident(column_name),data_type,
CASE WHEN identity_kind='a' THEN 'GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY' WHEN identity_kind='d' THEN 'GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY' END,
CASE WHEN generated_kind='s' THEN 'GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('||default_expr||') STORED' WHEN generated_kind='v' THEN 'GENERATED ALWAYS AS ('||default_expr||') VIRTUAL' END,
CASE WHEN default_expr IS NOT NULL AND generated_kind='' THEN 'DEFAULT '||default_expr END,
CASE WHEN collation_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'COLLATE '||collation_name END,
CASE WHEN not_null THEN 'NOT NULL' END) AS column_ddl
FROM raw), numbered AS (SELECT row_number() over(order by relation_name COLLATE "C", position)::int AS schema_ordinal,*,md5(column_ddl) AS column_ddl_md5 FROM norm)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',(SELECT count(*) FROM numbered),'rows',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(numbered) ORDER BY schema_ordinal) FROM numbered)) AS data

findings.description: public.shots and public.community_shots ratio generated as yield_g/dose_g; visible CHECK constraints independently verified dose_g >=5 and <=40 in both, preventing zero denominator in accepted rows.
public.bags has nine remaining persistent historical columns despite retirement of Bag Management UI. Not evidence of unused data or safe table/column deletion.
public.coffee_submissions.owner_id and public.library_entries.owner_id use DEFAULT auth.uid(); this is not itself access control. Previously verified RLS/ACL boundaries remain independently required.

public.shots.is_dialed_in is stored generated from exact five criteria extraction=3,body=3,clarity=5,sweetness=5,astringency=1; those ranges and community equality constraints were inspected. Match to all UX/Locked decisions not re-certified in this column pass.
private.import_control saves_enabled defaults FALSE, singleton true; beta_invites.uses defaults zero, unique token_hash and CHECK constraints verified, but application enforcement remains separate.
DDL/ACL/RLS observations do not prove real hosted PostgREST JWT or Realtime subscriptions reachability. Continue #96 coordination.

limitations: Column declaration components only; no live member rows, Storage bytes, Auth identities, sensitive logs, backend executables, or real signed-in HTTP requests.
Prior object-level table constraints/functions/ACL receipts are not re-credited as newly read; native C implementation unavailable.
No correction/safe removal established; no app code changes or isolated SQL/Node22 test performed in this run.
All provider settings not accessible through the connector remain unverified.
